content: श्रीमत् {%a.%} .²1 Wealthy, rich. .²2 Happy, fortunate, prosperous, thriving. .²3 Beautiful, pleasing; श्रियः पतिः श्रीमति शासितुं जगत् <ls>Śi. 1. 1</ls>. .²4 Famous, celebrated, glorious, dignified; (the word is often used as a respectful affix to celebrated or revered names of persons and things as श्रीमद्भागवत, श्रीमच्छंकराचार्य <ab>&c.</ab>). --{%m.%} .²1 An epithet of Viṣṇu. .²2 Of Kubera. .²3 Of Śiva. .²4 The {%Tilaka%} tree. .²5 The Aśvattha tree. .²6 A parrot. .²7 A bull kept for breeding.
